name: FloatyHeader – Sticky Header
author: Aman Brar

sections.description:
FloatyHeader makes it effortless to create sticky headers or navigation bars without writing code. Target header element by class or ID, customize its style, and control its behavior on different devices.

Enhance user experience by keeping key navigation elements visible as users scroll, with smooth animations and responsive controls.

✨ Features

🎨 Scroll Transition Effects – Add smooth Fade or Slide animations when your header becomes sticky.

🖌️ Custom Sticky Background & Text Color – Fully control your sticky header’s look with live color pickers.

📏 Offset Control – Set the scroll distance before your header sticks to the top.

📱 Mobile-Friendly Control – Option to disable sticky behavior on mobile devices for improved responsiveness.

🎯 Improved Styling – Enhanced handling for links, buttons, icons, and SVGs in sticky state.

⚡ Optimized Performance – Lightweight updates to keep your site fast and conflict-free.

✅ Additional Highlights

  • Works with any theme or page builder.
  • Simple and clean UI with live previews.
  • Easy setup – no coding required.

FloatyHeader is perfect for developers, designers, and site owners who want sticky functionality without bloated features or complex setup.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > FloatyHeader and configure your options.
sections.faq:
Can I target any header?

Yes, just enter the CSS class or ID of the element you want to make sticky.

Does this work with all themes?

Yes, it works with all standard and modern themes.

Can I disable the sticky header on mobile?

Yes, you can toggle this option in the plugin settings.
